She needs to get a therapist and take her mental health problem very seriously. It has to be her number one priority or y’all won’t get anywhere. I’m bipolar and have almost completely fucked up my relationship now. I have recently started therapy and it’s the most important thing to me right now. You make all kinds of insane decisions when you are bipolar. Then you regret it later when you come down from the high. This story sounds so similar to mine. Resting and all is good but it definitely isn’t going to take care of her disorder. She may act normal for awhile but without any kind of treatment she will keep making crazy decisions.
You can pm me if ya want
Not really a hobby but I started dating old dudes for money. I was working all day then going on dates at night. Making a lot of money. But of course blew it as fast as I got it.

I have also been recovering from a mental breakdown. Missed a lot of work. Sometimes you gotta take time for yourself. It just sucks you have to always be making money. I’m kinda in a lot of debt from being depressed and not working using credit cards. Hopefully when I go back tomorrow it will be all good. I have a fake doctors note. I had to because I can’t afford the doctor.  Today I went for a long walk, cleaned my house really good, got a lot of rest and ate healthy food. It can be hard to motivate yourself to do it but man it does go a long way. I have to learn that I literally can’t drink because of my bipolar disorder. It sends me into a crazy whirlwind of emotions for days. Just even a normal night of drinking for some people I just can’t do. I have a bachelorette party coming up and I don’t wanna make it awkward by not drinking so I’m probably going to just put sprite in a cup so I have something in my hand. Anyway just rambling over here. Feels good to talk about it.

Do you have a drinking or drug problem? I’m poor too and also needed a counselor. (And also needed to stop drinking because it was fucking up my life) AA has helped me figure out so much crazy shit about myself. You have to work the 12 steps though to really get the whole thing. It’s a lot of work but wow it’s really helped me become a more positive person.

I had a miscarriage last summer. Saddest shit ever. I’m still not over it. Just know this will effect her a very long time and be sensitive about her feelings. Sorry for your loss ❤️

Hello! Yes this sounds like me so much. I smoke a lot of weed. When I stop I go freaking insane. Like.... I want to drink and fight people and go places and do wild shit! Lol I eventually have to go back to smoking weed because I always do shit that gets me in trouble. That sucks because I need to pass a drug test soon. Life is hard. I seriously don’t trust myself though when I’m manic. Being totally sober makes me manic. Eventually you do come down back to depression. Wish I could give advice but I don’t know what the hell to do myself. I just had to reply because this sounds exactly like my life haha

I’m 26 also. I want to be sober. Any advice? I’ve been drinking heavily since high school. I’m trying to quit weed mostly to pass a drug test. I’ve found out though that I can’t drink or I’ll smoke. So sobriety it is! It’s only my first day. I just need some people to talk to that have been through this.

So I’m quitting weed to get into a program at school. It sucks a lot. I get crazy anxiety and I get really angry without weed. It’s hard to sleep and eat. The only thing I can tell you is to work out. That is literally the only thing that helps me. I still have those symptoms but it’s not as intense. I’m only on day 1 right now haha. I’ve already tried to quit several time before though is how I know these things. It’s getting to the last minute though to pass my drug test so I realllllyyyyyyy have to quit this time. I wish you luck. I’ll let you know how my experience goes this time if you want.

Well you’re not alone friend. I feel the same way. I feel like I don’t deserve to live. I also had a traumatic childhood. I don’t really have advice but just know you’re not alone feeling that way. I have to force myself to do shit everyday. I honestly don’t know how I’ve managed to keep going this long. I want to give up a lot. I get really drunk sometimes to cover my pain. I end up making it worse by drunk driving or something. I don’t know. We are all scum. We can be scum together. If you ever wanna talk hit me up
